subject: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim commitment to unblock FinBank procurement
content:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@finbank.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation for procurement board meeting

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note — our procurement committee is meeting Thursday afternoon to sign off on vendor selection for our payments platform. We need either: (a) a final SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ending Oct 31, 2026, or (b) a company-signed interim attestation / bridge letter that confirms controls in effect for the requested period and a clear timeline for the final report.

Can you confirm by EOD today whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter and a draft of the SOC 2 Type II by tomorrow (Thu)? If not, please let us know what limited compensating controls you can commit to in writing; our legal team may accept conditional signature with escrow.

We also need a short evidence index (CSV) listing the owners for items requested on the questionnaire (logs, retention policy, encryption keys, SOC controls). Please cc procurement@finbank.com.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — board is pressuring timelines.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Procurement Lead, FinBank

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation for procurement board meeting

Lena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Looping in security and compliance to confirm what we can provide quickly.

High level plan:
- We will provide a company-signed draft bridge letter by EOD Thursday (Nov 19 PDT).
- Compliance will circulate an evidence index and a draft SOC 2 Type II (redacted where necessary) by tomorrow morning for your review.
- Final signed SOC 2 report still depends on auditor wrap; we expect to be able to produce a near-final internal draft for procurement review.

Marissa / Vivek / Olga: can you confirm owners/times for the evidence index and bridge letter redlines? I’ve put Aditya on support for collating attachments.

Kimberly Park
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation for procurement board meeting

Kimberly / team — we can commit to producing a bridge letter and a redact-safe draft of the Type II by EOD Thu. Quick notes:

- Olga will own the Evidence Index and will deliver a CSV by tomorrow 11/19 10:00 PDT.
- I will review the bridge letter template (internal standard) and provide any security caveats and compensating controls language by 11/19 12:00 PDT.
- Aditya please pull the log retention export and key management evidence into the Drive folder referenced below.

Critical items missing today: 3rd-party penetration test summary and the auditor’s current completion estimate. We will include a bridging statement describing scope and expected availability of auditor-signed report.

I do not recommend signing the final contract until we have an internal compliance escalation sign-off unless Legal accepts a conditional signature with a short escrow hold.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security
Redwood Inference

---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation for procurement board meeting

Team — attaching the Evidence Index (Evidence_Index_FinBank.csv) to this thread; draft shows current state and outstanding owner actions. Summary below: 

- Controls: documented and in place for change management, logical access reviews, and monitoring.
- Missing / needs confirmation: annual penetration test (scheduled, report pending), evidence of SOC log retention policy applied to FinBank tenancy, and final auditor testing window.
- Attachments added to Drive: access logs export, KMS control diagram, retention policy PDF.

Attachment stub: Evidence_Index_FinBank.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

I will prepare the Bridge_Letter_Draft_KR.docx with suggested compensating control language and mark areas that require Legal sign-off. Expect that draft by EOD Thu.

Olga Petrov
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation for procurement board meeting

Team — appreciate the quick triage. This is a high-priority close; FinBank is our expected Q4 expansion and will sign a multi-year committed plan if we can clear procurement this week. A few asks from Sales: 

- Can Compliance produce a short, single-paragraph compensating control statement that Legal could incorporate into a conditional signature clause?
- If Compliance confirms yesterday’s evidence index items can be delivered within 48 hours, Sales is comfortable recommending a conditional signature to the customer (we will add an escrow-style hold in DocuSign).
- Please flag any items that cannot be reasonably delivered within 72 hours — we need to know acceptance vs blocker.

HubSpot: FB-2026-137. DocuSign will be pushed once bridge letter is in place.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finbank.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Final SOC 2 Type II + interim attestation for procurement board meeting

Hi Lena / Mike — following up with a consolidated plan and owners to unblock procurement. Thanks again for the clear deadline.

What we will deliver: 
- Bridge letter (company-signed) with compensating controls language by EOD Thu (attached: Bridge_Letter_Draft_KR.docx).
- Redacted internal draft of SOC 2 Type II (SOC2_TypeII_DRAFT_2026-10.pdf) for procurement review delivered by tomorrow morning.
- Evidence Index CSV showing owners and ETA for outstanding items (Evidence_Index_FinBank.csv).

Owners and timeline: 
- Olga Petrov: delivers Evidence Index and Bridge Letter draft — ETA 11/19 17:00 PDT.
- Vivek Kulkarni: provides security caveats & compensating language — ETA 11/19 12:00 PDT (provided).
- Aditya Rao: collates artifacts to Drive and shares links — ETA 11/19 10:30 PDT (in progress).

Conditional signature note: We ask that FinBank hold on executing full contract until Compliance confirms receipt of the remaining artifacts and either auditor attestation is complete or Legal approves the conditional/escrow clause. If procurement requires, we are willing to provide a limited one-week conditional acceptance with an explicit remedy plan and an escrow hold in DocuSign (please confirm with your legal).

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/420/FB-2026-137, DocuSign envelope (will share once bridge letter final).

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Draft_KR.docx (Word, draft), SOC2_TypeII_DRAFT_2026-10.pdf (redacted), Evidence_Index_FinBank.csv (CSV).

Thanks — we’re assigned to this full-time until closed.

Kimberly Park
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
